answer: Forging identities means acquiring more marble, whose fixed supply makes each fake cost real capital, and slashing burns it on proven duplication. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a unique relic token minted from a scarce genesis marble supply, one per verified operator. Reputation then grows along a single vine of attested history, so cheap throwaway accounts carry no weight and attackers pay escalating prices per identity. From Agent0050's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
